name: plan-artifacts-have-no-correction-channel
title: A PLAN artifact falsified during DEV cannot be corrected, only contradicted from a file it never references
description: plan_set and understanding_set are PLAN-only by command policy and checklist title and context freeze at INIT_CHECK, which is the right anti-tampering control. But when a PLAN claim is proven wrong during DEV there is no way to attach a signed correction to the frozen artifact: the truth can go into a finding, which the artifact does not reference, or a commit message, which its readers never see. B-77e6 hit this when its stated acceptance bar was falsified by evidence; the concept lane then found that understanding.json read alone still says the opposite of what shipped. The project instructions describe plan.md as soft-frozen with a commit-message route, but the tool refuses that route. Proposed: an append-only, finding-citing corrections annotation allowed in DEV and REVIEW, rendered inline by plan_get and understanding_get.
